nodes.label: Boundary decision tree (five ordered questions)
nodes.rationale: Work top to bottom at the boundary; first yes wins. Continue is ruled out first because it costs nothing and loses nothing. /compact is the default but last: starting there produces a session confidently wrong about decisions the summary flattened.

nodes.label: Primary vs secondary source trade
nodes.rationale: Every move except Continue turns the session as it happened (primary: full information, lots of noise, little room to move) into a summary (secondary: lossy, less noise, lots of room). The lossiness is only paid when staying costs more than it saves.
